vocabulary.meaning: 能够（can的过去式）；可以；可能（表推测）
各形各色的，各种各样的

examples.text: So, regular work is added to keep up your interest as well as to keep pace with new work.
examples.translation: 因此，会增加常规工作，以保持你的兴趣，并跟上新工作的进度。
examples.speechText: So, regular work is added to keep up your interest as well as to keep pace with new work.

examples.text: This allows the employer to get a sense of how the candidate interacts with other people and whether the candidate is truly curious and interested in how the company runs.
examples.translation: 这能让雇主了解求职者如何与他人互动，以及求职者是否真的对公司的运作方式感到好奇和感兴趣。
examples.speechText: This allows the employer to get a sense of how the candidate interacts with other people and whether the candidate is truly curious and interested in how the company runs.

examples.text: I missed（miss的过去式） this opportunity to bond with them from the very beginning.
examples.translation: 我从一开始就错过了与他们建立联系的机会。
examples.speechText: I missed this opportunity to bond with them from the very beginning.

examples.text: For every writer kissed by fortune, there are thousands more whose longing is never rewarded.
examples.translation: 每一个被命运眷顾的作家，背后都有成千上万的人，他们的渴望却始终得不到回应。
examples.speechText: For every writer kissed by fortune, there are thousands more whose longing is never rewarded.

examples.text: Use of a running machine can reduce some risks（risk的复数形式）, says Dufek.
examples.translation: Dufek说，使用跑步机能够降低某些风险。
examples.speechText: Use of a running machine can reduce some risks, says Dufek.

examples.text: Until recently, most of that concern has focused on the land portion of the planet, where pollution directly affects people in their daily lives.
examples.translation: 直到不久前，人们的这种担忧大多集中在地球的陆地部分，因为那里的污染会直接影响人们的日常生活。
examples.speechText: Until recently, most of that concern has focused on the land portion of the planet, where pollution directly affects people in their daily lives.

examples.text: One who loves birds should plant trees, so that the house shall be surrounded with hundreds of shady branches（branch的复数形式） and be a home for birds.
examples.translation: 爱鸟的人应该种树，让房屋被数百枝浓荫环绕，成为鸟儿的家。
examples.speechText: One who loves birds should plant trees, so that the house shall be surrounded with hundreds of shady branches and be a home for birds.

examples.text: Injuries and deaths were relatively fewer in Los Angeles because the quake occurred at 4:31 a.m. on a holiday, when traffic was light on the city’s highways.
examples.translation: 洛杉矶的伤亡人数相对较少，因为地震发生在一个假日的凌晨4点31分，当时市内高速公路上的车辆很少。
examples.speechText: Injuries and deaths were relatively fewer in Los Angeles because the quake occurred at 4:31 a.m. on a holiday, when traffic was light on the city’s highways.

examples.text: His new appointment takes effect from the beginning of next month.
examples.translation: 他的新任命从下个月月初起生效。
examples.speechText: His new appointment takes effect from the beginning of next month.

examples.text: Why are many people eager to be influencers?
examples.translation: 为什么许多人渴望成为网红？
examples.speechText: Why are many people eager to be influencers?

examples.text: One driver tapping the brakes can cause traffic jams even if drivers cooperate well.
examples.translation: 即使驾驶员们配合良好，一名驾驶员踩刹车也可能造成交通堵塞。
examples.speechText: One driver tapping the brakes can cause traffic jams even if drivers cooperate well.

examples.text: First, if the national economy grows, companies hire more workers.
examples.translation: 首先，如果国民经济增长，公司就会雇用更多员工。
examples.speechText: First, if the national economy grows, companies hire more workers.

examples.text: At the time of economic crisis, he could only earn a salary of $ 2,000 per month.
examples.translation: 在经济危机时期，他每月只能挣 2000 美元的薪水。
examples.speechText: At the time of economic crisis, he could only earn a salary of $ 2,000 per month.

examples.text: On my journey by car across the European Continent, I enjoyed looking at the scenery of the various countries.
examples.translation: 我开车穿越欧洲大陆旅行时，很喜欢欣赏不同国家的风景。
examples.speechText: On my journey by car across the European Continent, I enjoyed looking at the scenery of the various countries.
